SYNTHESIS (Review-0..3 + ledger + corpus search):

IMPLEMENTED GUARANTEES:
• Pin enforcement: state["pins"] check (l656) blocks pinned object retirement
• Session root protection: session_roots list validation (l655)
• Runtime dependency: active task effects/grants checked (l657-660, dataflow policy)
• Version validation: isinstance(int) check (l405-406) rejects bools; conflict detection (l466-468)
• Epoch increment on retire (l97); retired list append (l661)

LIMITATIONS:
• Race window: pin validation (l656) → retired append (l661) gap allows concurrent pin insertion
• Missing semantics: append version increment undocumented
• Snapshot scope: retention_until_tasks_complete (l777) defines contract; runtime external
• Concurrency: scope boundaries unverified for concurrent pin/retire

PROPOSED TEST:
Concurrent race test: Pin object X, spawn retire(X) in background thread, attempt pin(X) concurrently. Verify RuntimeError("object still pinned") consistently raised despite timing window. Validates atomicity of pin check against retirement.

All reads executed: review-0..3, ledger, corpus search for 'def retire'.
